overview_description.description: The Accounter is a fintech and accounting platform that provides affordable bookkeeping, accounting, VAT, invoicing, and financial management services for startups and SMEs. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Dubai, the company combines cloud technology, AI, OCR, and human accounting expertise to simplify financial operations for small businesses.
